svg:
Resonance tube: determination of v and end-correction e
<line x1="100" y1="60" x2="100" y2="240" stroke="#222" stroke-width:2"/> closed open → tuning fork f
<line x1="200" y1="150" x2="200" y2="240" stroke="#1f5fa8" stroke-width:2"/> l1 = λ/4 + e (1st resonance) <line x1="350" y1="90" x2="350" y2="240" stroke="#1f5fa8" stroke-width:2"/> l2 = 3λ/4 + e (2nd resonance)
v = 2f(l2 - l1), e = (l2 -3l1)/2 Derived: l1 = λ/4 + e, l2 = 3λ/4 + e → subtract → λ=2(l2-l1). Valid: l1,l2 ≫ r, small amplitude, f fixed
